procedure: Exported the lab files of the named commit with git archive into uncommitted private staging outside the repository.
Ran the setup command mvn -q dependency:go-offline in starter/ against an empty private local Maven repository, then the starter test command mvn -q -o test twice.
Replaced only starter/src/main/java/pep/books/BookApp.java with the privately staged completed class; the public tests were byte-identical to the commit.
Ran mvn -q -o test, then mvn -q -o clean.
result: mvn -q -o test exited 0 with no output; surefire report: Tests run: 4, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0.
starterRun: On the shipped starter, mvn -q -o test exits 1 and fails exactly the three declared failingTests (Tests run: 4, Failures: 3), with identical Task 1 and Task 2 failure lines on two runs: POST /books gets 404 (no route), GET /books does not list Dune, and GET /books/99 gets 500 (no exception handler). existingBookStillAnswers200 passes.
variantRuns: Private variants, not committed, each over the otherwise solved class: answering with the book read from the body (id 0) fails task1PostAnswers201WithTheSavedBookAsJson; leaving the status unset (200) fails the same test; a text error body via ctx.result fails task2MissingBookAnswers404WithAJsonError; mapping a different exception class fails the same test (500).
cleanup: The runs created only starter/target inside the lab, which mvn -q -o clean and the documented cleanup remove; the private Maven repository stays outside the repository.
otherSystems: Linux and Windows runs are not yet recorded; CI covers Ubuntu (lab-contract section 10).
testScope: The public tests check only HTTP responses from the running app (status codes, JSON content type and bodies); they do not check which Java constructs the handlers use.
